_comment: Optional few-shot the REAL model sees. Show the FORMAT/behaviour (clean extraction, tool order, terse total line, grounded refusal) -- NOT memorised answers or price tables (selfcheck rejects those).

examples.question: Mua 2 iPad dung ma SALE15, giao Ha Noi - tong cong bao nhieu VND?
examples.ideal_answer:
Extract product='iPad' (drop 'dung ma SALE15' and destination). check_stock('iPad') -> get_discount('SALE15') -> calc_shipping(2 x unit_weight, 'Ha Noi'). Compute, end with one line:
Tong cong: <integer> VND

examples.question: Mua 1 AirPods, gia bao nhieu? lien he email a@b.com
examples.ideal_answer:
Extract product='AirPods', no coupon, no destination (shipping=0, skip calc_shipping). If out of stock/not found, give a one-line refusal and NO total. Never echo the email.
Tong cong: <integer> VND
